sentences.en: How about giving me a promotion from just-a-friend to boyfriend?
sentences.zh: 你能不能把我从普通朋友提升到男朋友？

sentences.en: I am sure your promotion was timely and well deserved.
sentences.zh: 我相信你的晋升来得正是时候，也是实至名归。

sentences.en: I have to set up a budget for sales promotion.
sentences.zh: 我需要为促销活动制定一个预算。

senses.zh: 提升，晋级 - 宣传；推销 形容词: promotional
